entities.summary: Dorte Mandrup-Poulsen is a Danish architect. Founder and Creative Director of the architectural practice Dorte Mandrup Arkitekter A/S that has approximately 80 employees. The practice is based in Copenhagen, Denmark and has designed several internationally acclaimed buildings.
